candidates.change_summary: Replace the line that sets acc.unlockTime so it always sets unlockTime to the provided _unlockTime without clamping to current block.timestamp (allows setting past times).
Replace the line that adds msg.value to acc.balance with an assignment that sets acc.balance equal to msg.value (drops prior balance).
Insert a requirement that deposits must be at least MinSum, causing small puts to revert and thus change observable behavior.
Replace the logging call to log a different Data string, changing the external observable log history after Put.
Delete the line that updates acc.unlockTime so the unlock time remains unchanged by Put calls.
Change the withdrawal condition from strict greater-than on unlockTime to greater-than-or-equal-to, allowing collect when timestamp == unlockTime.
Remove the minimum-sum requirement so users can Collect even if their balance is below MinSum.

Invert the funds transfer success check so that Collect logs only when the external call failed (i.e., treat _s == false as success for logging and revert on true), altering observed behavior after Collect.
